thread:
marta_cs: Heads up — AzureLeaf asked for a temporary allowlist + regional egress bump ahead of their renewal. They said they'll run a demo spike next week and flagged renewal if performance dips. Need ops + SRE sync on CIDRs, QPS, window.

devon_sre: Can you paste the exact CIDRs, desired QPS, and the start/end window? Also confirm whether they're on Hosted vs Dedicated/Private.

marta_cs: IPs: 18.205.0.0/16, 52.23.45.0/24
Current QPS: ~600; request: burst to 2000 for the window
Window: 2026-04-05T00:00Z -> 2026-04-12T00:00Z
Tenant: hosted (org: azureleaf-prod)
Reason: sales demo + internal canary; renewal call in 13 days. cc @sam_sales

sam_sales: Marking renewal risk = HIGH if we can't support the spike. I'm adding a note in the renewal tracker: https://go.redwood/renewals (row added). Please set auto-revoke and TTL so this doesn't persist into their billing cycle.

leo_ops: Proposed plan: create an ephemeral allowlist entry and apply a per-org burst QPS policy. Name: azureleaf-pre-renew-324567. TTL 7d, auto-revoke. Will also attach an autoscale hint to prefer CA region fleet. I'll wait for devon sign-off.
Commands to apply (internal):
```
redwood-admin allowlist add --name azureleaf-pre-renew-324567
  --cidrs 18.205.0.0/16,52.23.45.0/24
  --org azureleaf-prod
  --qps 2000
  --start 2026-04-05T00:00Z
  --end 2026-04-12T00:00Z
  --auto-revoke
```

devon_sre: OK — + please set routing prefer_ca_central1 and failover to us-west1. Also add KV cache warmup for their top-50 prompt prefixes before window start. Note: estimated cost impact ~+15% for that week. Add a short roll-back playbook in case of unexpected surge.

config-bot: allowlist created (id: alw-89321) and policy attached to org azureleaf-prod. start=2026-04-05T00:00Z end=2026-04-12T00:00Z qps=2000. Link: https://internal.redwood/allowlists/alw-89321

marta_cs: Thanks — I'll inform the customer (include the start/end and auto-revoke) and update CSM notes + the renewal spreadsheet. Please add a dashboard watch and alert me at 85% usage so we can act early.

leo_ops: Added watch: dashboard/azureleaf-prod/egress/burst -> alert @marta_cs @sam_sales at 85%. Also added short rollback steps to the allowlist page.

marta_cs: Closing loop for now. I'll post back after the first 2 hours of the spike with usage summary. :thumbsup:
